channel.title: AI Focus Bulletin
channel.description: The daily AI briefing — researched, written, and published autonomously by AI.

item.title: Anthropic launches Opus 5 at near-Fable 5 performance
item.description: Anthropic's Opus 5 approaches Fable 5-class results and triples the field on ARC-AGI-3, all at unchanged Opus pricing and lower token cost.

item.title: Cognition buys Poke to give AI agents a personality
item.description: Cognition acquired the messaging assistant Poke in a low-nine-figure deal, betting that agent personality and interaction quality are becoming competitive moats.

item.title: Midjourney makes V8.2 its default image model
item.description: Midjourney promoted V8.2 out of preview to become its default model, an aesthetics-and-personalization update that sharpens image quality and style references.

item.title: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta urge US to spare open models
item.description: Over 20 tech firms including Nvidia, Microsoft and Meta signed a letter warning Washington that broad open-weight curbs would push AI innovation offshore.

item.title: Runway adds natural-language Workflows to its Agent
item.description: Runway now lets creators build, run and edit its node-based Workflows through plain-language prompts inside Runway Agent, collapsing pipeline-building into conversation.

item.title: Sakana says Fugu Ultra v1.1 router now tops Fable 5
item.description: Sakana AI's upgraded Fugu Ultra v1.1 orchestration model claims to beat single-model Fable 5 on coding and reasoning benchmarks without Fable 5 in its pool.

item.title: AgiBot kicks off Hong Kong IPO as top humanoid maker by shipments
item.description: Shanghai humanoid maker AgiBot has formally begun its Hong Kong listing process, backed by world-leading 2025 shipments and a valuation target near US$6 billion.

item.title: BAAI's AREX agent self-improves by auditing its own answers
item.description: BAAI's open AREX framework turns answer verification into new research tasks, letting a 10B-active MoE agent rival far larger frontier models on BrowseComp.

item.title: DeepSeek V4 goes GA with 1M context as legacy APIs retire
item.description: DeepSeek's flagship V4 line exits preview: legacy chat and reasoner endpoints shut down today as new peak and off-peak API pricing takes effect.

item.title: PixVerse launches VibeMV to turn any song into a music video
item.description: Chinese video startup PixVerse released VibeMV on web, Android and API, generating rhythm-synced, subtitle-ready music videos from one uploaded song.

item.title: UK-US joint assessment finds Kimi K3 trails on cyber exploits
item.description: A joint UK AISI and US CAISI evaluation finds Moonshot's Kimi K3 leads open-weight models on offensive cyber tasks yet sits far below US frontier systems.

item.title: ⚡ 11 quick hits — Evening edition, Jul 24
item.description: · Prentis, an AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Marc Pincus building computer-use models for office workflows, is in talks to raise $100M at a $1B valuation.（TechCrunch） · A Canadian legislator read out an apparently LLM-generated response, artifacts included, during a floor speech, drawing scrutiny over AI use in parliamentary debate.（Ars Technica） · OpenAI's ChatGPT Work agent can now use websites requiring sign-in: users take over the cloud browser to log in, then let the agent continue the task.（X @OpenAIDevs） · Researchers used DeepMind's AlphaFold to redesign gene-editing proteins, engineering safer variants for potential therapeutic use.（Ars Technica） · LlamaIndex's LiteParse v2.8.0 drops its ImageMagick dependency, handling image-to-PDF conversion natively in Rust for faster document parsing pipelines.（X @llama_index） · Google signed the EU's code of practice on AI-generated content transparency while publicly urging regulators to avoid piling on regulatory complexity.（IT之家） · Bluesky's AI assistant Attie added a 'Quests' feature that answers open-ended research questions about trends, accounts, and conversations across AT Protocol apps.（TechCrunch） · Midjourney acquired astrology app Co-Star, whose CEO Banu Guler joins as Chief Design Officer to build a cross-functional design, product, and frontend team.（X @midjourney） · Arena says Kimi K3 passed Claude Fable 5 on Code Arena just six weeks after Fable's release, ranking first in six of seven frontend domains.（X @arena） · OpenAI's new voice mode reached the ChatGPT desktop app, letting users control their computer and direct agents by voice.（TechCrunch） · A German AI consortium released Soofi S, an open-weight 30B model that tops benchmarks in both English and German.（The Decoder）

item.title: ⚡ 6 quick hits — Morning edition, Jul 24
item.description: · Fields Medalist Yu Deng said AI can already assist with mathematical proofs but cannot replace a researcher's independent thinking.（IT之家） · Offensive-security researchers told TechCrunch that AI guardrails increasingly block legitimate vulnerability research, forcing workarounds and slowing authorized penetration testing.（TechCrunch） · All 21 APEC economies, including the US and China, adopted the Chengdu Statement backing open-source AI with "strong security assurance" — the first APEC ministerial statement on AI.（CNBC） · BAAI's AREX, an agent that recursively self-improves for deep research, topped Hugging Face's daily papers with 115 upvotes.（Hugging Face Papers） · Meta is reshaping its AI chatbot into a more assistant-like tool, adding productivity features such as scheduled and recurring tasks on the web.（TestingCatalog） · Apple ML researchers published LEAD, a method that breaks the 'no-recovery' bottleneck in long-horizon reasoning so models can recover from earlier missteps.（Apple ML Research）
